outlet: The Spokesman-Review, 'People are our programs: Two Cheney School District levies on November ballots' (Nina Culver, 2026-09-10)
notes: Superintendent Ben Ferney: 'It's not new taxes'; $2.10 below the $2.50 maximum; EP&O nearly 20% of a $105 million budget; capital levy pays for security cameras, replacement Chromebooks, roof, carpeting, HVAC; combined $3.90 vs $3.93; board goal under $4; levies moved from February to November.
